```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 120
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)

condition_levels <- c(
  "Control_Group", "Control_Group_Bonus",
  "AI_Group_Flat", "AI_Group_Bonus"
)
condition_labels <- c(
  Control_Group = "Control (no incentive)",
  Control_Group_Bonus = "Control + incentive",
  AI_Group_Flat = "LLM (no incentive)",
  AI_Group_Bonus = "LLM + incentive"
)
figure_font <- "sans"
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12, base_family = figure_font) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
)

# Knitting uses the directory containing this R Markdown file.
figure_dir <- file.path("output", "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_,
         ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}


```

# Data preparation

The analysis uses participant scores and LLM request logs.

```{r load-public-data}
read_public <- function(name) read.csv(
  file.path("data", name), na.strings = c("", "NA"),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
participants_all <- read_public("participants_public.csv")
ai_consultations <- read_public("ai_consultations_public.csv")
score_rounds <- c("bl", "t1", "t2", "test", "del")
participants_all <- participants_all %>%
  mutate(attention_check_passed = as.logical(attention_check_passed))
# Unique participant IDs prevent joins from duplicating observations.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(participants_all$participant_id))

```

```{r prepare-public-participants}
score_proportion <- function(correct, total) {
  ifelse(!is.na(total) & total > 0, correct / total, NA_real_)
}
for (phase in score_rounds) {
  correct <- participants_all[[paste0(phase, "_score_correct")]]
  total <- participants_all[[paste0(phase, "_score_total")]]
  stopifnot(all(total >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            all(correct >= 0 & correct <= total, na.rm = TRUE))
  participants_all[[paste0(phase, "_score_proportion")]] <- score_proportion(correct, total)
}
participants_all <- participants_all %>%
  mutate(
    consent_withdrawn = status == "withdrawn",
    assigned = group_condition %in% condition_levels,
    has_baseline = !is.na(bl_score_proportion),
    has_training_1 = !is.na(t1_score_proportion),
    has_training_2 = !is.na(t2_score_proportion),
    has_immediate_test = !is.na(test_score_proportion),
    has_delayed_test = !is.na(del_score_proportion),
    attention_check_missing = is.na(attention_check_passed),
    attention_check_passed = coalesce(attention_check_passed, FALSE),
    declined_data_use = coalesce(use_data_for_study == "no", FALSE),
    ai = ifelse(assigned, as.integer(group_condition %in%
                  c("AI_Group_Flat", "AI_Group_Bonus")), NA_integer_),
    incentive = ifelse(assigned, as.integer(group_condition %in%
                         c("Control_Group_Bonus", "AI_Group_Bonus")), NA_integer_),
    condition_label = factor(unname(condition_labels[group_condition]),
                             levels = unname(condition_labels[condition_levels])),
    predicted_proportion = score_proportion(test_predicted_correct, test_prediction_n_items),
    metacognitive_bias = predicted_proportion - test_score_proportion,
    included_retention = assigned & !consent_withdrawn & !declined_data_use & has_baseline
  )
sample_steps <- list(
  "Approved on Prolific" = participants_all$recruitment_status == "APPROVED",
  "Consent not withdrawn" = !participants_all$consent_withdrawn,
  "Continued after baseline" = participants_all$assigned,
  "Reached immediate unaided test" = participants_all$has_immediate_test,
  "Passed the attention check" = participants_all$attention_check_passed,
  "Honesty check approved" = !participants_all$declined_data_use
)
sample_kept <- Reduce(`&`, sample_steps, accumulate = TRUE)
participants_all <- participants_all %>%
  mutate(
    included_primary = sample_kept[[length(sample_kept)]],
    exclusion_reason = case_when(
      consent_withdrawn ~ "Consent withdrawn",
      !assigned ~ "Dropped out after baseline",
      !has_immediate_test ~ "No immediate test",
      !attention_check_passed ~ "Attention check not passed",
      declined_data_use ~ "Excluded: honesty check not approved",
      TRUE ~ "Included"
    )
  )
participants <- participants_all %>%
  filter(included_primary) %>%
  mutate(baseline_c = bl_score_proportion - mean(bl_score_proportion))

```

## Primary-sample age

Age statistics are calculated from `primary_sample_age_aggregates.csv`; individual ages are omitted from the public data.

```{r primary-sample-age}
age_aggregates <- read_public("primary_sample_age_aggregates.csv")
# The anonymised age aggregates must describe the analysed sample.
stopifnot(age_aggregates$n_participants == nrow(participants))
age_summary <- age_aggregates %>%
  transmute(
    N = n_participants,
    N_age = n_age,
    N_missing_age = n_participants - n_age,
    Mean_age = sum_age / n_age,
    SD_age = sqrt((sum_squared_age - sum_age^2 / n_age) / (n_age - 1)),
    Min_age = min_age,
    Max_age = max_age
  )
knitr::kable(age_summary, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0))
cat(sprintf(
  "The mean age of participants in the primary sample was %.1f years (SD = %.1f, range = %d–%d).\n",
  age_summary$Mean_age, age_summary$SD_age,
  age_summary$Min_age, age_summary$Max_age
))
```

LLM use is defined as at least one request, counted across the 14 training items and separately for each item.

```{r prepare-public-consultation}
request_counts <- ai_consultations %>%
  count(participant_id, training_session, item_position, name = "prompt_count") %>%
  rename(position = item_position)
ai_training_items <- tidyr::crossing(
  participant_id = participants$participant_id[participants$ai == 1],
  training_session = 1:2, position = 1:7
) %>%
  left_join(request_counts, by = c("participant_id", "training_session", "position")) %>%
  mutate(prompt_count = coalesce(prompt_count, 0L), any_use = prompt_count > 0) %>%
  left_join(participants %>% select(participant_id, incentive), by = "participant_id")
participant_consultation <- ai_training_items %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  summarise(used_ai_training = any(any_use),
            ai_consulted_items_percent = 100 * mean(any_use), .groups = "drop")
participants <- participants %>% left_join(participant_consultation, by = "participant_id")
ai_item_consultation <- ai_training_items %>%
  group_by(incentive, training_session, position) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), consulted = sum(any_use), percent = 100 * mean(any_use),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(incentive, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No incentive", "Incentive")),
    session = factor(training_session, levels = c(1, 2),
                     labels = c("Practice session 1", "Practice session 2")),
    item_position = factor(position, levels = 1:7)
  )
recorded_training_counts <- participants %>% filter(ai == 1) %>%
  select(participant_id, t1_ai_requests_count, t2_ai_requests_count) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(t1_ai_requests_count, t2_ai_requests_count),
               names_to = "training_session", values_to = "recorded_requests") %>%
  mutate(training_session = ifelse(training_session == "t1_ai_requests_count", 1L, 2L)) %>%
  left_join(ai_training_items %>% group_by(participant_id, training_session) %>%
    summarise(observed_requests = sum(prompt_count), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("participant_id", "training_session"))
# Reconcile request logs with participant-level totals before analysing LLM use.
stopifnot(all(
  recorded_training_counts$recorded_requests == recorded_training_counts$observed_requests
))
```

# Results from pilot data

The performance model (Equation 1) tests H1–H6; the metacognitive-bias model (Equation 2) tests H7. The performance and learning-trajectory mixed models use restricted maximum likelihood (REML) and Satterthwaite degrees of freedom for contrasts and confidence intervals.

```{r design-table-models}
design_equivalence_d <- c(H1 = .20, H2 = .20, H3 = .20, H4 = .20,
                          H5 = .10, H6 = .10, H7 = .10)

pooled_cell_standardizer <- function(outcome, group) {
  keep <- complete.cases(outcome, group)
  cells <- split(outcome[keep], factor(group[keep]))
  cell_n <- vapply(cells, length, integer(1))
  if (any(cell_n < 2L)) {
    stop("Equivalence standardization requires at least two observations per cell.")
  }
  list(
    sd = sqrt(sum((cell_n - 1) * vapply(cells, var, numeric(1))) / sum(cell_n - 1)),
    df = sum(cell_n - 1)
  )
}

summarize_design_contrast <- function(grid, weights, hypothesis, outcome,
                                      direction, standardizer) {
  bound <- design_equivalence_d[[hypothesis]] * standardizer$sd
  comparison <- contrast(
    grid, method = setNames(list(weights), hypothesis), adjust = "none"
  )
  result <- as.data.frame(confint(comparison, level = .90, adjust = "none"))
  standardized <- as.data.frame(summary(
    emmeans::eff_size(comparison, sigma = standardizer$sd,
                      edf = standardizer$df, method = "identity"),
    infer = c(FALSE, FALSE)
  ))
  p_directional <- emmeans::test(
    comparison, side = if (direction == "negative") "<" else ">", adjust = "none"
  )$p.value
  p_equivalence <- emmeans::test(
    comparison, delta = bound, side = "two-sided", adjust = "none"
  )$p.value
  data.frame(
    Hypothesis = hypothesis, Outcome = outcome,
    Contrast = dplyr::case_when(
      hypothesis %in% c("H1", "H2", "H7") ~ "LLM − control, no incentive",
      hypothesis %in% c("H3", "H4") ~ "Incentive − no incentive, LLM",
      TRUE ~ "LLM × incentive"
    ),
    estimate = result$estimate, SE = result$SE, df = result$df,
    CI_low = result$lower.CL, CI_high = result$upper.CL,
    standardizing_sd = standardizer$sd, standardizing_df = standardizer$df,
    cohens_d = standardized$effect.size, equivalence_bound = bound,
    p_one_sided = p_directional, p_equivalence = p_equivalence,
    Interpretation = dplyr::case_when(
      p_directional < .05 & p_equivalence < .05 ~
        "Evidence in predicted direction; equivalent within bounds",
      p_directional < .05 ~ "Evidence in predicted direction",
      p_equivalence < .05 ~ "Equivalent within bounds",
      TRUE ~ "Inconclusive"
    )
  )
}

fit_design_table <- function(dat) {
  long <- dat %>%
    select(participant_id, ai, incentive, baseline_c,
           Immediate = test_score_proportion, Delayed = del_score_proportion) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(Immediate, Delayed), names_to = "time", values_to = "performance") %>%
    filter(complete.cases(performance, baseline_c)) %>%
    mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("Immediate", "Delayed")))
  performance_model <- lme4::lmer(
    performance ~ time * (ai * incentive + baseline_c) + (1 | participant_id),
    data = long, REML = TRUE
  )
  performance_grid <- emmeans(
    performance_model, ~ ai * incentive | time,
    at = list(ai = c(0, 1), incentive = c(0, 1), baseline_c = 0),
    lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
  )
  # Explicit grid order: control/no incentive, LLM/no incentive,
  # control/incentive, LLM/incentive.
  stopifnot(
    identical(as.numeric(performance_grid@grid$ai), rep(c(0, 1, 0, 1), 2)),
    identical(as.numeric(performance_grid@grid$incentive), rep(c(0, 0, 1, 1), 2))
  )
  results <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Immediate", "Delayed"), function(assessment) {
    grid <- performance_grid[performance_grid@grid$time == assessment, ]
    observed <- long %>% filter(time == assessment)
    no_inc <- observed %>% filter(incentive == 0)
    ai_only <- observed %>% filter(ai == 1)
    numbers <- if (assessment == "Immediate") c("H1", "H3", "H5") else c("H2", "H4", "H6")
    no_inc_scale <-
      pooled_cell_standardizer(no_inc$performance, no_inc$ai)
    ai_only_scale <-
      pooled_cell_standardizer(ai_only$performance, ai_only$incentive)
    interaction_scale <- pooled_cell_standardizer(
      observed$performance, interaction(observed$ai, observed$incentive))
    bind_rows(
      summarize_design_contrast(grid, c(-1, 1, 0, 0), numbers[1], assessment,
        "negative", no_inc_scale),
      summarize_design_contrast(grid, c(0, -1, 0, 1), numbers[2], assessment,
        "positive", ai_only_scale),
      summarize_design_contrast(grid, c(1, -1, -1, 1), numbers[3], assessment,
        "positive", interaction_scale)
    )
  }))
  # Equation 2 specifies H7 without baseline adjustment.
  bias_model <- lm(metacognitive_bias ~ ai * incentive, data = dat)
  bias_grid <- emmeans(bias_model, ~ ai * incentive,
    at = list(ai = c(0, 1), incentive = c(0, 1)))
  no_inc <- dat %>% filter(incentive == 0)
  bias_scale <-
    pooled_cell_standardizer(no_inc$metacognitive_bias, no_inc$ai)
  results <- bind_rows(results,
    summarize_design_contrast(bias_grid, c(-1, 1, 0, 0), "H7", "Immediate bias",
      "positive", bias_scale)) %>%
    arrange(Hypothesis)
  list(performance_model = performance_model, bias_model = bias_model,
       performance_grid = performance_grid, long = long, results = results)
}

format_design_results <- function(results) {
  results %>% transmute(
    Hypothesis, Outcome, Contrast,
    `Effect (pp)` = sprintf("%.2f", 100 * estimate),
    `90% CI (pp)` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", 100 * CI_low, 100 * CI_high),
    `Cohen's d` = sprintf("%.2f", cohens_d),
    `One-sided p` = fmt_p(p_one_sided),
    `Equivalence bounds (d)` = sprintf("±%.2f", equivalence_bound / standardizing_sd),
    `Equivalence p` = fmt_p(p_equivalence),
    Interpretation
  )
}

design_table <- fit_design_table(participants)
```

```{r design-table-model-summaries}
knitr::kable(coef(summary(design_table$performance_model)),
             digits = 3, caption = "Performance model: fixed effects")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(design_table$performance_model)),
             digits = 3, caption = "Performance model: variance components")
knitr::kable(coef(summary(design_table$bias_model)),
             digits = 3, caption = "Metacognitive-bias model: coefficients")
bias_summary <- summary(design_table$bias_model)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  N = nobs(design_table$bias_model),
  Residual_SE = bias_summary$sigma,
  Residual_df = df.residual(design_table$bias_model),
  R_squared = bias_summary$r.squared,
  Adjusted_R_squared = bias_summary$adj.r.squared,
  F = unname(bias_summary$fstatistic["value"]),
  Numerator_df = unname(bias_summary$fstatistic["numdf"]),
  Denominator_df = unname(bias_summary$fstatistic["dendf"])
), digits = 3, caption = "Metacognitive-bias model: fit statistics")
```

The H1–H7 contrasts and two-sided 90% confidence intervals are expressed in percentage points. Cohen’s d uses the applicable pooled within-cell SD. The table also reports one-sided directional tests and equivalence tests with bounds of ±0.20 within-cell SD units for H1–H4 and ±0.10 for H5–H7.

## Performance results figure

Figure 3 shows observed baseline means and baseline-adjusted immediate and delayed performance by condition, with 90% confidence intervals.

```{r performance-results-figure, fig.width=160/25.4, fig.height=135/25.4, dpi=300}
results_conditions <- tibble::tibble(
  condition = condition_levels,
  ai = c(0, 0, 1, 1), incentive = c(0, 1, 0, 1),
  label = c("Control", "Control + incentive", "LLM", "LLM + incentive"),
  colour = c("#808080", "#0072B2", "#7B3294", "#159E7C"),
  shape = c(16, 17, 15, 18), open_shape = c(21, 24, 22, 23),
  size = c(2, 2.3, 1.8, 2.5), panel_x = c(1, 4, 2, 3),
  offset = c(-.06, -.02, .02, .06)
)
results_colours <- setNames(results_conditions$colour, results_conditions$condition)
results_shapes <- setNames(results_conditions$shape, results_conditions$condition)
results_open_shapes <- setNames(results_conditions$open_shape, results_conditions$condition)
results_sizes <- setNames(results_conditions$size, results_conditions$condition)
results_labels <- setNames(results_conditions$label, results_conditions$condition)
results_offsets <- setNames(results_conditions$offset, results_conditions$condition)
results_font <- "Helvetica"
results_ci_level <- .90
results_y_limits <- c(30, 70)
results_time_x <- c(Baseline = 1, Immediate = 3.3, Delayed = 4.5)
results_practice_x <- c(1.7, 3)
results_bracket_y <- 71
results_dimensions <- c(width = 160, height = 135)
results_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 7, base_family = results_font) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .25),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .25),
    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(1, "mm"),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 3, 1, 3, unit = "mm")
  )

results_cells <- as.data.frame(confint(
  design_table$performance_grid, level = results_ci_level, adjust = "none"
)) %>%
  left_join(results_conditions, by = c("ai", "incentive")) %>%
  transmute(ai, incentive, group = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels),
            assessment = factor(time, levels = c("Immediate", "Delayed")),
            centre = emmean, lower = lower.CL, upper = upper.CL, x = panel_x)
results_baseline_cells <- participants %>%
  transmute(group = factor(group_condition, levels = condition_levels),
            score = bl_score_proportion) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), centre = mean(score), spread = sd(score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    assessment = "Baseline",
    lower = centre - qt((1 + results_ci_level) / 2, n - 1) * spread / sqrt(n),
    upper = centre + qt((1 + results_ci_level) / 2, n - 1) * spread / sqrt(n)
  )
results_trajectory_cells <- bind_rows(
  results_baseline_cells %>% select(group, assessment, centre, lower, upper),
  results_cells %>% transmute(group, assessment = as.character(assessment), centre, lower, upper)
) %>%
  mutate(
    assessment = factor(assessment, levels = names(results_time_x)),
    x = results_time_x[as.character(assessment)] + results_offsets[as.character(group)]
  )
results_practice_paths <- results_trajectory_cells %>%
  filter(assessment == "Immediate") %>%
  left_join(results_trajectory_cells %>% filter(assessment == "Baseline") %>%
              select(group, baseline_x = x, baseline_mean = centre), by = "group")

results_trajectory_panel <- ggplot(results_trajectory_cells, aes(x, colour = group, shape = group)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = results_practice_x[1], xmax = results_practice_x[2],
           ymin = results_y_limits[1], ymax = results_y_limits[2], fill = "#F2F2F2", colour = NA) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(results_practice_x), y = 67.5, label = "Practice",
           family = results_font, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = 7 / ggplot2::.pt) +
  geom_segment(data = results_practice_paths,
               aes(x = baseline_x, y = 100 * baseline_mean, xend = x, yend = 100 * centre),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = filter(results_trajectory_cells, assessment != "Baseline"),
            aes(y = 100 * centre, group = group), linewidth = .4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper),
                width = 0, linewidth = .4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = filter(results_trajectory_cells, assessment == "Baseline"),
             aes(y = 100 * centre, size = group), fill = "white", stroke = .4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = filter(results_trajectory_cells, assessment != "Baseline"),
             aes(y = 100 * centre, size = group, fill = group), stroke = .2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = results_colours, labels = results_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = results_open_shapes, labels = results_labels, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = results_colours, guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = results_sizes, guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                              override.aes = list(fill = unname(results_colours))),
         shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(results_time_x[1], mean(results_practice_x), results_time_x[2:3]),
    labels = c("Baseline\nDay 0", "2 practice sessions\n+1 week",
               "Immediate test", "Delayed test\n+1 week"),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(results_y_limits[1], results_y_limits[2], 10),
                     expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(.65, 4.8), ylim = results_y_limits) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Unaided performance (%)", title = "Baseline and follow-up performance", tag = "a") +
  results_theme +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold", hjust = .5),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = "topleft",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(6, "mm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm")
  )

results_annotations <- design_table$results %>%
  filter(Hypothesis %in% c("H1", "H2", "H3", "H4")) %>%
  mutate(
    assessment = factor(Outcome, levels = c("Immediate", "Delayed")),
    x_start = ifelse(Hypothesis %in% c("H1", "H2"), 1, 2),
    x_end = x_start + 1,
    bracket_left = ifelse(x_start == 1, 1, 2.06),
    bracket_right = ifelse(x_end == 3, 3, 1.94),
    stars = case_when(
      p_one_sided < .001 ~ "***", p_one_sided < .01 ~ "**",
      p_one_sided < .05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    p_label = paste0("italic(P) == '", formatC(p_one_sided, digits = 3, format = "f"), "'"),
    p_label = ifelse(stars == "", p_label, paste0(p_label, "~'", stars, "'"))
  )

  assessment = factor(c("Immediate", "Delayed"), levels = c("Immediate", "Delayed")),

)

  geom_segment(data = results_annotations,

               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .25) +
  geom_text(data = results_annotations,
            aes(x = (bracket_left + bracket_right) / 2,

            inherit.aes = FALSE, family = results_font, size = 7 / ggplot2::.pt,

  geom_text(data = results_assessments,
            aes(x = .4, y = results_bracket_y + 1, label = panel),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, family = results_font, fontface = "bold",
            size = 8 / ggplot2::.pt, hjust = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ assessment, nrow = 1, strip.position = "top", axes = "all_y", axis.labels = "all_y") +
```

# Effects of financial incentive on LLM use

LLM uptake is the percentage of LLM-assigned participants who made at least one request. Welch’s test compares the participant-level percentage of training items consulted between incentive conditions.

```{r appendix-ai-consultation}
appendix_ai_consultation <- participants %>%
  filter(ai == 1) %>%
  group_by(incentive) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(), Users = sum(used_ai_training),
    `Any LLM use (%)` = 100 * mean(used_ai_training),
    `Items with LLM use (%)` = mean(ai_consulted_items_percent),
    `Items with LLM use SD (pp)` = sd(ai_consulted_items_percent),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Condition = ifelse(incentive == 0, "No incentive", "Incentive")) %>%
  select(Condition, N, Users, `Any LLM use (%)`, `Items with LLM use (%)`,
         `Items with LLM use SD (pp)`)
knitr::kable(appendix_ai_consultation, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1))
ai_item_welch <- with(filter(participants, ai == 1), t.test(
  ai_consulted_items_percent[incentive == 1],
  ai_consulted_items_percent[incentive == 0],
  alternative = "two.sided", conf.level = .95
))
appendix_ai_item_contrast <- data.frame(
  Contrast = "Incentive minus no incentive",
  Difference_pp = unname(ai_item_welch$estimate[1] - ai_item_welch$estimate[2]),
  CI_low = ai_item_welch$conf.int[1], CI_high = ai_item_welch$conf.int[2],
  t = unname(ai_item_welch$statistic), df = unname(ai_item_welch$parameter),
  p = fmt_p(ai_item_welch$p.value)
)
knitr::kable(appendix_ai_item_contrast, digits = 2)
```

# Changes in unaided performance without LLM assistance

Among participants without incentives, a mixed model estimates performance by assessment, LLM assignment, and their interaction, with a random intercept for each participant.

```{r control-learning-model}
trajectory_participants <- participants %>%
  filter(incentive == 0) %>%
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    ai_group = factor(
      ai,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Control", "LLM")
    ),
    Baseline = bl_score_proportion,
    Immediate = test_score_proportion,
    Delayed = del_score_proportion
  )

trajectory_long <- trajectory_participants %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Baseline, Immediate, Delayed),
    names_to = "time",
    values_to = "score"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("Baseline", "Immediate", "Delayed")))

trajectory_model <- lme4::lmer(
  score ~ time * ai_group + (1 | participant_id),
  data = trajectory_long,
  REML = TRUE
)
```

Control-group learning gains compare immediate and delayed performance with baseline, with 95% confidence intervals.

```{r no-ai-baseline-gains}
no_ai_means <- emmeans(
  trajectory_model, ~ time | ai_group, lmer.df = "satterthwaite"
)
no_ai_gains <- as.data.frame(summary(contrast(
  no_ai_means, method = list(
    "Immediate - Baseline" = c(-1, 1, 0),
    "Delayed - Baseline" = c(-1, 0, 1)
  ), adjust = "none"
), infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))) %>%
  filter(ai_group == "Control")
knitr::kable(no_ai_gains %>% transmute(
    Comparison = contrast,
    `Gain (pp)` = sprintf("%.2f", 100 * estimate),
    `95% CI (pp)` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", 100 * lower.CL, 100 * upper.CL)
  ))
```

```{r control-learning-figure-data}
  no_ai_means, level = .95, adjust = "none"

  transmute(
    time, performance_percent = 100 * emmean,
    CI_low_percent = 100 * lower.CL, CI_high_percent = 100 * upper.CL

control_learning_gains <- no_ai_gains %>%
  transmute(
    assessment = factor(sub(" - Baseline", "", contrast, fixed = TRUE),
                        levels = c("Delayed", "Immediate")),
    gain_pp = 100 * estimate,
    CI_low_pp = 100 * lower.CL, CI_high_pp = 100 * upper.CL,
    gain_label = sprintf("%+.2f pp", gain_pp)
  )
control_learning_n_labels <- setNames(
  sprintf("%s\n(n = %d)", control_learning_counts$time,
          control_learning_counts$n_observed),
  as.character(control_learning_counts$time)
```

# Participant flow

The flow table applies exclusions cumulatively. Session counts and retention rates use assigned participants with baseline data who did not withdraw consent or decline data use. Completion means a score is available; Pearson chi-square tests compare retention across the four conditions.

```{r participant-flow}
flow_steps <- list(
  "Recruited and approved on Prolific" = participants_all$recruitment_status == "APPROVED",
  "Consent retained" = !participants_all$consent_withdrawn,
  "Honesty check approved" = !participants_all$declined_data_use,
  "Passed attention check" = participants_all$attention_check_passed,
  "Baseline data available" = participants_all$has_baseline,
  "Continued beyond baseline" = participants_all$assigned,
  "Completed Training 1" = participants_all$has_training_1,
  "Completed Training 2" = participants_all$has_training_2,
  "Completed immediate test: primary sample" = participants_all$has_immediate_test,
  "Completed delayed test" = participants_all$has_delayed_test
)
flow_kept <- Reduce(`&`, flow_steps, accumulate = TRUE)
sample_flow <- data.frame(
  Step = names(flow_steps),
  Remaining = vapply(flow_kept, sum, integer(1))
) %>%
  mutate(Removed = lag(Remaining) - Remaining) %>%
  select(Step, Removed, Remaining)

retention_counts <- participants_all %>%
  filter(included_retention) %>%
  group_by(group_condition, condition_label) %>%
  summarise(n_assigned = n(), n_training_1 = sum(has_training_1),
            n_training_2 = sum(has_training_2), n_immediate = sum(has_immediate_test),
            n_delayed = sum(has_delayed_test), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(condition_label)
knitr::kable(sample_flow, caption = "Cumulative participant flow")

session_flow <- retention_counts %>%
  transmute(Condition = as.character(condition_label),
    `Continued beyond baseline (n)` = n_assigned, `Training 1 completed (n)` = n_training_1,
    `Training 2 completed (n)` = n_training_2, `Immediate completed (n)` = n_immediate,
    `Delayed completed (n)` = n_delayed)
session_flow <- bind_rows(session_flow,
  data.frame(Condition = "Pooled", as.list(colSums(session_flow[-1])), check.names = FALSE))
knitr::kable(session_flow, caption = "Session completion by condition")
retention_transitions <- list(
  "Training 1 to immediate" = c("n_training_1", "n_immediate"),
  "Training 1 to delayed" = c("n_training_1", "n_delayed"),
  "Immediate to delayed" = c("n_immediate", "n_delayed")
)
retention_by_condition <- bind_rows(lapply(names(retention_transitions), function(label) {
  columns <- retention_transitions[[label]]
  data.frame(
    Condition = as.character(retention_counts$condition_label), Transition = label,
    Eligible = retention_counts[[columns[1]]], Completed = retention_counts[[columns[2]]],
    `Retention (%)` = 100 * retention_counts[[columns[2]]] / retention_counts[[columns[1]]],
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
pooled_retention <- retention_by_condition %>%
  group_by(Transition) %>%
  summarise(Condition = "Pooled", Eligible = sum(Eligible), Completed = sum(Completed),
            `Retention (%)` = 100 * Completed / Eligible, .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(match(Transition, names(retention_transitions))) %>%
  select(Condition, Transition, Eligible, Completed, `Retention (%)`)
knitr::kable(bind_rows(pooled_retention, retention_by_condition), digits = 1,
             caption = "Retention between assessments")

retention_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(names(retention_transitions), function(label) {
  counts <- filter(retention_by_condition, Transition == label)
  result <- chisq.test(cbind(Not_completed = counts$Eligible - counts$Completed,
                            Completed = counts$Completed), correct = FALSE)
  data.frame(Transition = label, Eligible = sum(counts$Eligible),
             `Chi-square` = unname(result$statistic), df = unname(result$parameter),
             p = fmt_p(result$p.value), check.names = FALSE)
}))
knitr::kable(retention_tests, digits = 2,
             caption = "Pearson chi-square tests of retention by condition")
```

# Correlation between baseline and subsequent unaided performance

Baseline–test correlations are calculated after removing condition means. Approximate 95% Fisher-z confidence intervals account for the three condition contrasts; the sample-size planning assumption is rho = .60.

```{r baseline-correlations-ci}
baseline_correlation <- function(dat, outcome) {
  dat <- dat[complete.cases(dat[, c("bl_score_proportion", outcome,
                                  "group_condition")]), ]
  x <- dat$bl_score_proportion
  y <- dat[[outcome]]
  n <- nrow(dat)
  condition_design <- model.matrix(~ factor(group_condition), data = dat)
  k <- qr(condition_design)$rank - 1L
  x <- lm.fit(condition_design, x)$residuals
  y <- lm.fit(condition_design, y)$residuals
  r <- cor(x, y)
  ci <- tanh(atanh(r) + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(.975) / sqrt(n - k - 3))
  data.frame(Outcome = outcome, N = n,
             r = r, CI_lower = ci[1], CI_upper = ci[2])
}

baseline_correlation_results <- bind_rows(lapply(
  c("test_score_proportion", "del_score_proportion"), function(outcome) {
    baseline_correlation(participants, outcome)
  }
))
appendix_baseline_correlations <- baseline_correlation_results %>%
  transmute(
    Assessment = ifelse(Outcome == "test_score_proportion", "Immediate", "Delayed"),
    N, r, `95% CI` = sprintf("[%.2f, %.2f]", CI_lower, CI_upper)
  )
knitr::kable(appendix_baseline_correlations, digits = 2)
cat("Sample-size planning assumption: rho = .60.\n")
```
